info.name: Library of Congress (loc.gov) API — incl. Chronicling America
info.description:
loc.gov JSON/YAML API — search, collections, formats, items and resources across the Library of Congress digital collections, including **Chronicling America** historic newspapers (now loc.gov-only), Sanborn maps, photos and manuscripts. No key.

**Rate limit: 20 requests/minute** for the JSON API (exceeding it blocks you for 1 hour; heavy load may return 429 or a CAPTCHA page). Text/image services: 150/min.

Docs: https://www.loc.gov/apis/json-and-yaml/ · Parameters: https://www.loc.gov/apis/json-and-yaml/requests/parameters/

exec: if(pm.response.code===429) console.warn('429 from loc.gov — pause; limit is 20 requests/minute (1-hour block if exceeded).');
if((pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')||'').includes('text/html')) console.warn('HTML returned — possibly a CAPTCHA/rate-limit page. Slow down.');

query.description: page = one result per newspaper page
YYYY/YYYY
e.g. location_state:new york  ·  location_city:new york  ·  partof_title:the sun (new york [n.y.]) 1833-1916  ·  subject_ethnicity:hungarians
json | yaml
results per page (default 25)
page number (1-based)
only these attributes, e.g. pagination,results — or at!=more_like_this to exclude
date | date_desc | title_s | title_s_desc | shelf_id | shelf_id_desc
facet filter name:value, pipe-separated, e.g. location_state:ohio|subject:wildlife
